individual-data-points.explanation: Spatial deconvolution plots display per-spot values as a color heatmap over tissue coordinates; this is analogous to a heatmap, where individual data points are not meaningful to overlay.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Spatial plots show per-spot deconvolution scores on a color scale with no error bars or summary statistics requiring definition.

individual-data-points.explanation: The box plots have individual data points (dots) overlaid for each sample, in addition to being an exempt box-plot type.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: The box plots represent the distribution of values for each group, extending from the 25th percentile to the 75th percentile; T11b-high LUSC: Classical monocyte (minima=0.00035, median=0.32265, maxima=1, Q1 = 0.16193, Q3 = 0.52806)...
error-bars-defined.explanation: Caption defines the box plot elements (25th-75th percentile boxes, median, and minima/maxima for whiskers) for each group and cell type.

individual-data-points.explanation: GSEA enrichment plots are line plots showing a single running enrichment score curve; overlaying individual points is not applicable.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Enrichment plots show a single NES curve per gene set with no error bars.

individual-data-points.explanation: Each bar represents a single log2 fold-change value from a genome-wide differential expression analysis (with an associated p value), not a mean of biological replicates, so individual data points are not meaningful to overlay.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Bar graph shows single log2 fold-change values per gene with p values labeled; no error bars are present.

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel contains H&E and IHC micrographs, not a plot.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel contains representative micrographs, not a plot.
